name: q7_condition3_cohesion
title: Condition 3: ΔQ against its band
caption: Condition 3 per cohort. ΔQ is the change in the average Gower distance between two aircraft against the two earliest cohorts, drawn under the one weighting of the form distance (w15): 15 dimensions of the codebook, each of its four systems weighing 1.
source: human labelling (every field of the distance) · PatSeer (priority date)
propulsor: unique aircraft per four-year priority cohort; 1000 permutations, seed 42; A, A·U and F read the same aircraft, A·W·T leaves out the aircraft whose wings or tilt are not recorded
read: Q is the average Gower distance between two aircraft of the cohort (0 = alike on every design field, 1 = no field shared); ΔQ is the cohort's Q minus the average Q of the two earliest cohorts. Grey band: the middle 95 % of ΔQ when the aircraft are shuffled among the cohorts; a red dot is below it (condition 3 met). Weights (w15): 15 dimensions of the codebook, each of its four systems (G1, M1, M2, M3) weighing 1.
